F-SV Tractor Garage: Seasonal & white

I made this for me and a friend, but than I decided to publish it. Here you find 4 tractor garages, one for every season.

[b][color=#ff0000]You need of course the tractor mod. BUT: It must be [u]4.1 (or higher!)[/u]. Here you find it:[/color] [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401/?tab=2&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D1401&pUp=1]Tractor mod from Pathoschild
[/url][/b]

This is a combination of different mods, with a few little changes from myself. And a lot of help from [b]Acerbicon[/b] and [b]Pathoschild[/b]. Here you find my resources:

- For this wonderful [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891/?]Seasonal Victorian houses  [/url]I have done my garages (you can use them with every house mod of course). Thanks a lot to [b]Eemiestardew[/b] for her permission. Please enjoy her great mods:  [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615/?tb=mods&pUp=1]Eemie's stunning mod collection
[/url]
- Here I found the white garage: [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/barfys-fancy-farmhouses-and-other-addons-update-links-are-back-up.112984/]barfy's Fancy Farmhouses [/url]There is a lot of great stuff there, take a look.

- [b]Acerbicon[/b], my friend: Without you I would be lost. Can't thank you often enough. I'm in love with your [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/988/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D988%26preview%3D&pUp=1]Incredible Farm-Map Collection[/url] .

- The basic idea to make a seasonal mod came from [b]Entoarox[/b]. You find him here: [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-seasonal-immersion.125683/]Entoarox Seasonal Immersion[/url]

- And: Pathoschild, our "modding goodness" and a  friendly & patient person. He "made all possible". Thanks :) Visit all of his [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317/?tb=mods&pUp=1]great mods & updates [/url].

[color=#ffe599][size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color]

- First you install SMAPI and of course the great Tractor mod.
- Than: Go to the place where you have installed all the mods and look for the tractor mod. Inside you find a folder called: [b]assets[/b]
- Please copy & paste all my 4 garage files inside this folder. You don't have to delete the default texture file inside.

(to uninstall please just delete my 4 files from the folder "assets")
